## Company Overview

MTK Screws (also written "mtkscrews", brand name of Aggarwal Industries) is an
ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and exporter of stainless steel industrial
fasteners, established in 1983 and based in Kasna Industrial Area, Greater
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.

The company operates both a manufacturing division (in-house production) and a
trading division (stocked and distributed products), providing customers with a
single supplier for a wide range of fastener requirements.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1983
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Standards: DIN, ISO, ANSI, IS (Bureau of Indian Standards), BS, JIS
- Manufacturing capacity: 1000+ metric tons per month
- Global clients: 4000+
- Export countries: 25+
- Production facility: A-003/11, Site-V, Kasna Industrial Area, Greater Noida, UP – 201310, India
- Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM IST

## Manufacturing Division

Products manufactured in-house at the Kasna facility in stainless steel grades
SS 201, SS 204, SS 304, and SS 316(L).

### Machine Screws (Manufactured)
Category slug: mfg-machine-screw
Thread range: M2 – M6 and 1/8 – 1/4 inch
Length range: 4 – 100 mm
Finish: Bright passivated / electropolished
Standards: ISO 1207, DIN 7985, IS 1366
Applications: Electrical & electronics assembly, sheet-metal fabrication,
industrial machinery, OEM assembly lines

Products:
1. Pan Phillips – Rounded pan head with Phillips cross-drive. Most common
   general-purpose machine screw. Tag: Bestseller.
2. CSK Phillips – Countersunk Phillips machine screw. Flush-sit installation.
3. Truss Phillips – Wide low-profile truss head. Distributes clamping load
   over thin material.
4. Combination – Combination drive (Phillips + slotted). Driveable with
   either screwdriver type.
5. Combiwasher – Pan head with integrated captive washer. Distributes load
   and prevents head damage.
6. CSK Head Torx – Countersunk head with Torx (star) recess. Flush finish
   with superior cam-out resistance. Tag: High Torque.
7. Torx Button Head – Low-domed button head with Torx (star) recess. Superior
   cam-out resistance for high-torque applications. Tag: High Torque.
8. LN Button Head – Button head with internal hex (Allen) drive. Low-profile
   alternative to socket cap screws.
9. LN CSK Head – Countersunk head with internal hex drive. Flush finish with
   Allen-key tightening.

### Self Tapping Screws (Manufactured)
Category slug: mfg-self-tapping
Thread range: #2 (2.4 mm) – #14 (6.3 mm)
Length range: 4.5 – 100 mm
Hardness: Case hardened HRC 28–38
Standards: DIN 7981, DIN 7982, IS 7510
Applications: Sheet-metal fabrication, HVAC ducting, white-goods assembly,
joinery and wood-to-metal connections

Products:
1. Pan Phillips – Rounded pan head with Phillips cross-drive. Most versatile
   general-purpose self-tapping screw. Tag: Bestseller.
2. CSK Phillips – Countersunk Phillips self-tapping screw. Flush finish in
   sheet metal, plastic and wood.
3. Truss Phillips – Wide low-profile truss head. Broad bearing surface for
   thin material.
4. Combiwasher – Pan head with integrated captive washer. Higher pull-out
   resistance. Tag: Popular.
5. Combination – Combination drive (Phillips + slotted). Service-friendly
   for field maintenance.
6. Wooden Screw – Coarse-pitch CSK self-tapping screw with sharp gimlet
   point. For softwood and hardwood. Threads #5–#10, lengths 20–100 mm.

## Trading Division

Stocked products for same-day or fast dispatch.

### Self Drilling Screws (Trading)
Category slug: trd-self-drilling
Material: Carbon steel / SS 304
Coating: Yellow zinc / Galvanised
Hardness: HRC 28–38
Standards: DIN 7504, ISO 15480
Applications: Metal roofing & cladding, HVAC ducting, steel-to-steel fastening,
greenhouse/shed construction

Products:
1. Hex Head SDS – Hex head self-drilling screw for metal-to-metal fastening.
2. EPDM Bonded Hex Flange Head SDS – Weatherproof seal for roofing applications.
3. Hex Head Stitching Screw – For joining overlapping metal sheets.
4. SDS Sockett – Magnetic hex socket driver for SDS installation. Accessory.
5. Cyclone Washers – Heavy-gauge EPDM sealing washer for metal roofing.
6. Truss Head SDS – Wide low-domed head. Distributes load over thin material.
7. CSK Head SDS – Countersunk head. Flush finish for metal-to-metal joints.
8. Pan Head SDS – Standard pan head for general drilling-and-fastening.
9. PH2 Bitt – Phillips #2 driver bit for cordless drills. Accessory.
10. EPDM Washer – Standalone EPDM-bonded washer for sealing.

### Self Tapping Screws (Trading)
Category slug: trd-self-tapping
Material: SS 304 / MS Zinc Plated
Hardness: HRC 28–38
Standards: DIN 7971, DIN 7981, IS 7510
Applications: Sheet-metal assembly, electrical enclosures, furniture,
white goods

Products:
1. Pan Slotted Screw – Pan head with slotted drive. Traditional hand-driven.
2. Pan Phillips Screw – Pan head with Phillips drive. High-volume workhorse.
   Tag: Stocked.
3. CSK Slotted Screw – Countersunk head with slotted drive. Flush finish.
4. CSK Phillips Screw – Countersunk Phillips. Flush finish for cabinetry.
5. Truss Head Screw – Wide truss head for thin or soft sheet.
6. Combination Head Screw – Phillips + slotted dual drive.
7. Combi-Washer Head Screw – Pan head with integrated captive washer.
8. Drywall Screw – Bugle head for fixing drywall to wood or metal studs.
   Tag: Bestseller.
9. Chipboard Screw – Coarse-pitch screw for chipboard, MDF, plywood.

### Machine Screws (Trading)
Category slug: trd-machine-screw
Material: SS 304 / MS Zinc Plated
Thread range: M3 – M12
Length range: 6 – 50 mm
Standards: ISO 7045, ISO 7046, DIN 7985
Applications: Industrial assembly, OEM production, maintenance, electrical panels

Products:

2. CSK Phillips Screw – Countersunk Phillips for flush-finish assemblies.
3. Truss Phillips Screw – Wide truss head for thin-material applications.
4. Combi-Washer Screw – Combination drive with integrated washer.

### Rivets (Trading)
Category slug: trd-rivets
Diameter range: 2.4 – 6.4 mm
Grip range: 1 – 18 mm
Materials: Aluminium / Steel / SS 304
Standards: DIN 7337, ISO 15983, IFI-114
Applications: Sheet-metal joining, ducting, signboard assembly

Products:
1. Aluminium Pop Rivet – Standard blind rivet. Aluminium body, steel mandrel.
   Tag: Bestseller.
2. Coloured Pop Rivet – Powder-coated head in 10+ colours for cladding panels.
3. Hammer Rivet – Solid drive-in rivet for plastic/wood fixings. No tool needed.
4. Tinmen Rivet – Solid tubular rivet for sheet-metal trade.
5. Double Hand Riveting Gun – Heavy-duty manual riveting gun. Tool.

### Fasteners / Anchors (Trading)
Category slug: trd-fasteners
Material: MS Zinc Plated / SS
Size range: M6 – M16
Length range: 50 – 150 mm
Standards: ETA approvals available, IS 1367
Applications: Concrete & masonry anchoring, structural steel fixings,
heavy machinery foundation, signage installation

Products:
1. Frame Fixing Fastener – Expansion sleeve anchor for window/door frames.
   Tag: Stocked.
2. Wedge Anchor Fastener – Heavy-duty wedge anchor for solid concrete.
3. Pin Type Fastener – Steel nail-in anchor for light to medium fixings.
4. Bolt Type Fastener – Hex-head sleeve anchor for through-bolting.
5. Hook Type Fastener – Hook-end anchor bolt for hanging from ceilings.
6. Coach Head Screw – Heavy hex-head wood screw (lag bolt) for timber.

### Allen Bolts (Trading)
Category slug: trd-allen-bolt
Grade range: 8.8 / 10.9 / 12.9 and SS 304
Thread range: M3 – M20
Length range: 6 – 100 mm
Standards: DIN 912, ISO 4762, DIN 7991
Applications: Machine assembly, precision tooling, restricted-access fastening,
high-strength joints

Products:
1. CSK Head LN Bolt – Countersunk Allen bolt. Flush finish, high-torque.
2. Truss Head LN Bolt – Wide low-profile truss head with internal hex drive.
3. LN Bolt – Standard socket head cap screw (Allen bolt). Tag: Bestseller.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is MTK Screws?
A: MTK Screws is the fastener brand of Aggarwal Industries, an ISO 9001:2015
certified manufacturer and trader of industrial stainless steel fasteners based
in Kasna Industrial Area, Greater Noida, India. Founded in 1983, MTK Screws
manufactures machine screws and self-tapping screws in-house and trades
self-drilling screws, rivets, allen bolts, and anchors — supplying 4000+
clients pan-India from a single source.

Q: Which is the best screw manufacturer in India?
A: The right fastener manufacturer depends on material grade, standards, and
volume needs — but a few things set MTK Screws (Aggarwal Industries) apart:
40+ years of manufacturing experience since 1983, ISO 9001:2015 certification,
in-house production of stainless steel machine screws and self-tapping screws,
a 99.8% quality pass rate across 15+ QC checkpoints, and 1000+ metric
tons/month capacity serving 4000+ clients. Combined with a stocked trading
division for self-drilling screws, rivets, allen bolts, and anchors, MTK
Screws gives buyers a single source for 52+ fastener products.

Q: What types of fasteners does MTK Screws manufacture?
A: MTK Screws manufactures precision stainless steel machine screws and
self-tapping screws in-house at its Kasna Industrial Area facility in Greater
Noida, and trades self-drilling screws, rivets, allen bolts, and structural
fasteners/anchors — a single supplier across 52 products in 8 categories.

Q: What stainless steel grades are available?
A: Manufactured products are available in SS 201, 204, 304, and 316(L). SS 304
is the most popular grade for general industrial applications; SS 316(L) is
recommended for marine, chemical, and outdoor environments requiring superior
corrosion resistance.

Q: Does MTK Screws supply custom-size fasteners?
A: Yes. MTK Screws manufactures custom fasteners based on customer drawings
and specifications, including non-standard thread pitches, special head
profiles, unusual lengths, and private labelling.

Q: Where is MTK Screws located?
A: The manufacturing facility is at A-003/11, Site-V, Kasna Industrial Area,
Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201310, India. Open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM
to 6:00 PM IST. Phone: +91 97112 21918.

Q: What is the difference between MTK Screws' manufacturing and trading
divisions?
A: Machine Screws (M2–M6) and Self Tapping Screws (#2–#14) are manufactured
in-house in SS 201, 204, 304 and 316(L). The other six categories (Self
Drilling Screws, additional Self Tapping/Machine Screw variants, Rivets,
Fasteners/Anchors, Allen Bolts) are stocked and supplied through the trading
division for fast dispatch — one supplier for both precision-manufactured and
stocked fastener needs.

Q: What does ISO 9001:2015 certification guarantee for a buyer?
A: A documented quality management system with 15+ quality control
checkpoints and a 99.8% quality pass rate, traceable batches, material test
certificates on request, and conformance to DIN, ISO, ANSI, IS, BS and JIS
standards.

Q: What is the difference between DIN 7981 and DIN 7982 self-tapping screws?
A: DIN 7981 is pan head (sits proud of the surface); DIN 7982 is countersunk
(CSK) head (sits flush). Both share the same case-hardened thread form (HRC
28–38) but differ in head shape for different finish requirements.

Q: How do I choose the right screw head and drive type?
A: Phillips is the general-purpose drive default; Torx and internal hex
(Allen) resist cam-out for high-torque work; slotted suits low-torque
hand-driven use. Pan heads are the general-purpose head default; CSK sits
flush; truss spreads load over thin material; combi-washer heads add a
captive washer against pull-through.

Q: What are the best self-drilling screws for metal roofing and cladding?
A: EPDM-bonded hex flange head self-drilling screws, optionally paired with
heavy-gauge Cyclone Washers for corrugated sheet sealing. DIN 7504 / ISO
15480, HRC 28–38.

Q: Which machine screws are best for electronics/electrical panel assembly?
A: Manufactured Pan Phillips or Combiwasher machine screws (M2–M6, SS
304/316(L), bright passivated or electropolished finish), made to ISO 1207,
DIN 7985, IS 1366.

Q: Machine screw vs self-tapping screw — what's the difference?
A: A machine screw needs a pre-tapped hole or nut and doesn't cut its own
thread — used for assemblies that may be disassembled. A self-tapping screw
cuts its own thread on install, which is faster where a pre-tapped hole isn't
practical (sheet metal, plastic, wood).

Q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
A: No minimum for standard stocked trading items. Manufactured products
typically start at 5,000 pieces per SKU.

Q: How do I request a quote?

(https://wa.me/919711221918). Include product name, material grade, thread
size, length, and quantity. Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM IST.

Q: Does MTK Screws export outside India?
A: Currently pan-India across 20+ states, actively working toward
international exports.
